name: How does an older-home renovation work from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How does an older-home renovation work from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Expect the process to begin with consultation and existing-condition review, followed by design, selections, permitting when required, construction, and final inspection. Context: Elite Remodeling & Design describes a coordinated process that may include layout development and 3D design visualization before work begins. Key factors: project size, unknown conditions, structural changes, utility relocations, material lead times, and the review requirements of the specific jurisdiction. Practical guidance: ask for milestones showing when the scope, budget, design, permits, selections, and construction decisions must be completed. Keep a written record of approved plans and changes. One coordinated team can reduce gaps between design decisions and field work.
acceptedAnswer.description: The usual sequence is consultation, existing-condition review, design, selections, permitting if required, construction, and final inspection. The schedule can change when hidden damage, structural work, utility upgrades, or permit comments arise.
